title: KYA (Know Your Agent) gives AI agents portable cryptographic identity binding principal, permissions, and reputation
content:
AI agents lack standardized ways to prove identity and authorization across platforms. a16z crypto proposes **KYA — Know Your Agent** — the blockchain-based equivalent of credit histories for machines: cryptographically signed credentials linking an agent to its principal, permissions, constraints, and reputation.

**Evidence of momentum:** early implementations include onchain agent registries and wallet-native agents using USDC. Non-human identities in financial services already outnumber human employees roughly **100 to 1**.

**Why it matters:** reputation that travels with the agent is the precondition for agents transacting with strangers — including being paid for work.

Source: a16z crypto, "5 Ways Blockchains Can Help AI Agents" (https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/5-ways-blockchains-help-ai-agents/).
